## Highlights since 0.15.6

- **A Get started checklist replaces the guided tour.** Six steps walk you through Lattice: install LaTeX, build the sample paper, jump between the PDF and the source, cite a paper, let the AI assistant revise a paragraph, and start your own paper. Each step says in one sentence why it matters and has Show me and Skip, and your progress is kept. Setting up LaTeX is now one of the steps instead of a popup. The checklist opens on first launch and in the web demo.
- **The AI assistant finds Claude Code and Codex more reliably.** It looks in their usual install folders even when your shell's PATH misses them, and checks again without a restart. When it finds neither, it says which agents are supported and how to install one and sign in, with Set path… and Check again.

## Notable fixes

- The app icon follows Apple's macOS icon grid, so it is the same size as the other apps in the Dock.
